lines.text: Many learners say: I am in the bus now.
Better: I am on the bus now.
On! I am on the train.

data.wrong: I am in the bus now.
data.right: I am on the bus now.
data.memory: On the bus, in the car.

native.tip: Para ônibus, trem e avião, usamos “on”. Para carro, “in”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I am in the bus now.”. O certo é “I am on the bus now.”. Em português dizemos “no ônibus”, mas inglês separa. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “on”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: For buses, trains and planes, we use “on”. For cars, “in”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I am in the bus now.”. The right way is “I am on the bus now.”. In Portuguese it is always “no”, but English splits them. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
